prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1046; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the presenting symptoms align well with that mechanism. Over the course of 27 visits, care proceeded along a typical trajectory, including conservative management with manual therapy, targeted stretching, and home exercise instruction. Visit frequency naturally decreased as symptoms improved and function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a cervical strain consistent with the reported injury. The patient reports no prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding musculature, and no earlier treatment for this region is known to this office. Billed services correspond to the documented care delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Patient was discharged with instructions to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recur.
